ei.title: The Impact of Light on Health

fullPassage:
The Impact of Light on Health

Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.

However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light.

In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night. This improves people's cognitive abilities and overall mental health.

questions.passage: Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it ①<u>boosts</u> vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces ②<u>to promote</u> happiness and pleasure and ③<u>reducing</u> depression and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are ④<u>linked</u> to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 행복을 촉진하고 우울증을 줄이기 위해.
det.analysis: ✅ ①boosts: 주어 it(단수) → boosts. ✅ ②to promote: 목적 to부정사. ✅ ④linked: be linked to(수동). ❌ ③reducing: to promote와 병렬 → reduce. reducing은 병렬 불가.
det.tip: to promote ... and reduce: to부정사 병렬 구조. and 뒤에도 원형(reduce)이 와야 함.

questions.passage: However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors ①<u>creating</u> by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by ②<u>lowering</u> levels of melatonin, a chemical ③<u>made</u> in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and ④<u>sleep-wake</u> cycles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 인공빛에 의해 만들어진 색깔.
det.analysis: ❌ ①creating: 수동 의미(인공빛에 의해 만들어진) → created. Colors created by(과거분사). ✅ ②lowering: by + V-ing. ✅ ③made: 과거분사(수동). ✅ ④sleep-wake: 복합형용사 정상.
det.tip: Colors created by(수동) (O) / Colors creating by(능동) (X). 색깔이 만들어지는 것이므로 수동.

questions.passage: In contrast, red and yellow light are the ①<u>least</u> likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can ②<u>improve</u> mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, ③<u>which</u> leads to better sleep at night. This improves people's ④<u>cognitively</u> abilities and overall mental health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 사람들의 인지적(cognitive) 능력.
det.analysis: ✅ ①least: the least likely(최상급 구문). ✅ ②improve: can + V(원형). ✅ ③which: 콤마 + which(계속적 용법). ❌ ④cognitively: 명사 abilities를 수식 → 형용사 cognitive. 부사 cognitively 불가.
det.tip: 형용사 + 명사: cognitive abilities (O) / cognitively abilities (X). 명사 수식 → 형용사.

questions.passage: Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and ①<u>heals</u> skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote ②<u>happiness</u> and pleasure and reduce depression and ③<u>anxiety</u>. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related ④<u>remedies</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛 감소는 공황 발작과 불안 관련 장애(disorders)에 연결된다. remedies(치료법)는 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①heals: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②happiness: 원문 그대로. ✅ ③anxiety: 원문 그대로. ❌ ④remedies: 원문은 disorders. 부정적 맥락에 치료법은 모순.
det.tip: disorders(장애) ↔ remedies(치료법). panic attacks와 병렬 → 부정적 단어여야 함.

Blue and white light ②<u>energize</u> us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by ③<u>raising</u> levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most ④<u>sensitivity</u> to blue light.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 파란빛은 멜라토닌 수치를 낮춰서(lowering) 수면을 방해한다. raising(올리는)은 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①artificial: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②energize: 원문 그대로. ✅ ④sensitivity: 원문 그대로. ❌ ③raising: 원문은 lowering. 수면 방해(disturb)의 원인이므로 낮추는 것.
det.tip: lowering(낮추는) ↔ raising(올리는). 멜라토닌 감소 → 수면 방해.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 뇌에서 만들어져 주야 주기와 수면-각성 주기를 조절하는 화학물질 = 멜라토닌.
det.analysis: ✅ ②melatonin: 수면 주기 조절. ❌ ①serotonin: 1문단 행복 촉진. ❌ ③dopamine: 본문 미언급. ❌ ④adrenaline: 본문 미언급.
det.tip: melatonin: 수면 조절. serotonin: 행복 촉진. 두 화학물질의 역할 구별.

det.tip: they(복수 대명사) = 앞 주어 Blue and white light(복수).
